documented_design_limits.title: Standalone headings (48,990 units / 481,721 bytes) and whitespace (514,659 units / 1,540,929 bytes) are not standalone passage embeddings
documented_design_limits.source_scope: All 7,708 train cases (M1 structural partition vs M2 navigation/passage parents)
documented_design_limits.expected: 100% of navigation content units (382,343 paragraph + unnumbered units = 223,375,957 bytes, 99.1026% of raw corpus bytes) are indexed into passages; standalone M1 headings and whitespace remain source-addressable and are preserved inside raw open_context envelopes without being claimed as standalone embeddings.
documented_design_limits.actual: Verified exact byte partition equality across all 7,708 cases: 223,375,957 (parent bytes) + 481,721 (48,990 heading units) + 1,540,929 (514,659 whitespace units) == 225,398,607 (total raw corpus bytes). Explicitly declared in case JSON field excluded_structural_views.

documented_design_limits.title: Split parent boundaries use whitespace/codepoint cuts, not certified sentence or legal-semantic boundaries
documented_design_limits.source_scope: 9,856 split parents (43,206 split child passages across 7,708 cases)
documented_design_limits.expected: Long parents (>448 full-input tokens) are split using tokenizer offset proposals snapped to whitespace (or codepoint fallback for unbroken strings) with boundary_method='whitespace_or_codepoint_fallback_not_sentence_verified', and full parent + neighbors are recovered on PassageReader.open_context.
documented_design_limits.actual: All 43,206 split children carry boundary_method='whitespace_or_codepoint_fallback_not_sentence_verified' (word_boundary_splits=0 across corpus; codepoint fallback verified on synthetic 9,000-char unbroken string). Manual review of 35 sampled split-parent regions confirms cuts frequently occur mid-sentence at whitespace near 320 tokens, while open_context recovers the complete parent and adjacent context.

documented_design_limits.title: Local profile (320 soft target / 128 content overlap / 448 hard cap) is a provisional within-parent overlap variant, not retrieval-quality optimized
documented_design_limits.expected: Parents <=448 full tokens stay intact (even when >320); parents >448 split with measured content-only overlap <=128. Overlap is not counted as independent case evidence or certified as retrieval-optimal prior to M3 evaluation.
documented_design_limits.actual: 9,742 parents with 320 < full_input_tokens <= 448 remain intact (split_count=1). Across 33,350 non-first split children, content-only overlap ranges from 90 to 128 tokens (mean 127.29; 22,275 at 128; 11,075 at 90..127 due to whitespace snapping), adding 4,244,972 overlap content tokens (+8.38% total full-input token expansion vs unsplit parents).

documented_design_limits.title: Local token validation does not certify Modal embedding endpoint compatibility or M4 agent delivery budgeting
documented_design_limits.expected: manifest.json and summary.json must keep dense_runtime='not_ready', embedding_runtime='not_ready', indexes='not_ready', runtime_compatibility='pending_endpoint_preflight', and open_context must set diagnostic_only=True and M4_delivery_recorded=False.
documented_design_limits.actual: All readiness flags and per-passage embedding_view metadata truthfully mark endpoint compatibility as pending preflight and M4 delivery as unrecorded.

documented_design_limits.title: Paragraph ownership (current_case/quoted/unknown) and language regions remain structural observations, not semantic truth
documented_design_limits.source_scope: All 415,693 passages (384,419 unknown, 1,278 quoted, 29,996 unnumbered/None, 14,289 French region)
documented_design_limits.expected: M2 propagates M1/navigation role, language_region, uncertainties, and role_evidence_refs verbatim without filtering, dropping, or merging unknown/quoted/French/unnumbered/no-preview units.
documented_design_limits.actual: 100% of navigation units (including 267 units without preview, 13,189 French parents, quoted and unknown units) are preserved without filtering or merging.
